action_runner_cloud_profile_check.name: action_runner_cloud_profile_check
action_runner_cloud_profile_check.value: "action_runner"."cloud_profile_id" IS NULL OR "action_runner"."cloud_pool_id" IS NOT NULL

action_workflow_github_check.name: action_workflow_github_check
action_workflow_github_check.value: "action_workflow"."controller" <> 'github' OR ("action_workflow"."owner" IS NOT NULL AND "action_workflow"."repo" IS NOT NULL AND "action_workflow"."source" IS NULL AND "action_workflow"."github_workflow_id" IS NOT NULL)

action_workflow_source_check.name: action_workflow_source_check
action_workflow_source_check.value: ("action_workflow"."owner" IS NOT NULL AND "action_workflow"."repo" IS NOT NULL) OR ("action_workflow"."owner" IS NULL AND "action_workflow"."repo" IS NULL AND "action_workflow"."source" IS NOT NULL)

uq_backup_policy_mail_server.name: uq_backup_policy_mail_server
uq_backup_policy_mail_server.where: "backup_policy"."mail_server_id" IS NOT NULL AND "backup_policy"."deleted_at" IS NULL

idx_backup_run_policy_batch.name: idx_backup_run_policy_batch
idx_backup_run_policy_batch.where: "backup_run"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "backup_run"."deleted_at" IS NULL

idx_backup_run_execution_in_flight.name: idx_backup_run_execution_in_flight
idx_backup_run_execution_in_flight.where: "backup_run"."execution_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "backup_run"."execution_finished_at" IS NULL

idx_build_session_live_project_deploymen.name: idx_build_session_live_project_deployment
idx_build_session_live_project_deploymen.where: "build_session"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "build_session"."finished_at" IS NULL

idx_docker_migration_execution_in_flight.name: idx_docker_migration_execution_in_flight
idx_docker_migration_execution_in_flight.where: "docker_migration_run"."execution_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "docker_migration_run"."execution_finished_at" IS NULL

project_workspace_target_check.name: project_workspace_target_check
project_workspace_target_check.value: "project"."workspace_id" IS NULL OR ("project"."server_id" IS NOT NULL AND "project"."cluster_id" IS NULL)

servers_migration_source_check.name: servers_migration_source_check
servers_migration_source_check.value:
"servers"."purpose" <> 'migration_source' OR (
      "servers"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "servers"."workspace_id" IS NULL AND NOT "servers"."is_local"
      AND "servers"."ssh_host" IS NOT NULL AND "servers"."ssh_host_key" IS NOT NULL
      AND "servers"."ssh_transport" = 'direct' AND "servers"."ssh_key_path" IS NULL
      AND "servers"."ssh_jump_host" IS NULL AND "servers"."ssh_args" IS NULL
      AND (("servers"."ssh_auth_method" = 'password' AND "servers"."ssh_password" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("servers"."ssh_auth_method" = 'key' AND "servers"."ssh_private_key" IS NOT NULL))
    )

servers_connection_check.name: servers_connection_check
servers_connection_check.value:
("servers"."workspace_id" IS NULL AND "servers"."ssh_host" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("servers"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL AND "servers"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT "servers"."is_local" AND "servers"."ssh_host" IS NULL
      AND "servers"."ssh_password" IS NULL AND "servers"."ssh_key_path" IS NULL
      AND "servers"."ssh_private_key" IS NULL AND "servers"."ssh_key_passphrase" IS NULL
      AND "servers"."ssh_jump_host" IS NULL AND "servers"."ssh_args" IS NULL)
